title: NTA AIAPGET 2026 Online Form
organization: National Testing Agency / Ministry of AYUSH
postName: All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET) 2026
vacancyDetails: Entrance for MD/MS/PG courses in Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy (AIQ & State Quota)
qualification: BAMS / BUMS / BSMS / BHMS or equivalent degree with internship as per NCISM/NCH rules
applicationFee: As per NTA AIAPGET fee structure (category-wise)
selectionProcess: CBT (120 MCQs, 480 marks, 120 minutes) → Counselling by AYUSH / state authorities
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://exams.nta.nic.in/aiapget/
2. New Registration → fill application
3. Upload photo, signature (live photo as required)
4. Pay fee by 30 July 2026 11:59 PM
5. Correction window 1–2 August 2026
shortDescription: NTA AIAPGET 2026 Online Form open 10–30 July 2026. Exam 22 August 2026 for AYUSH PG courses.
content:
NTA has started online registration for AIAPGET 2026 for postgraduate AYUSH programmes.

Dates

  • Apply: 10–30 July 2026
  • Correction: 1–2 August 2026
  • Exam: 22 August 2026 (CBT)

Portal: exams.nta.nic.in/aiapget.
